archetype: 1 (Organic & Earthy) mixed with Futuristic Tech - Clean White Base with Cyan/Teal Accents

layout.spacing_system: Generous spacing. Use p-8 to p-24 for sections to maintain a premium minimalist feel.
layout.grid: Bento Grid Protocol: strict hierarchy, dense but clean, using gap-6 or gap-8.

motion_and_interactions.hero_video_scrub: Use framer-motion useScroll and useTransform to map scrollYProgress to text opacity/y-position in the hero section, simulating a scrub effect with text overlays. Since we lack actual video frames, use a fixed background image or a high-quality robot render that slightly scales on scroll while text layers enter and exit.
motion_and_interactions.hover_effects: Interactive elements should increase cyan/teal glow intensity on hover using CSS box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0,240,255,0.6). Slight y-axis translation (-translate-y-1).
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: Staggered fade-up for list items. Elements should enter with opacity 0 to 1, and y from 20px to 0.

components.buttons: Background can be pure white with dark navy text and cyan border/glow, or solid dark navy with cyan text. On hover, emit a cyan glow. Include data-testid.
components.cards: White background, 1px border (#E2E8F0), soft shadow. On hover, apply a subtle cyan glow via box-shadow.
components.navigation: Sticky/fixed glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-gray-100). Logo on left, links in center, primary CTA on right.
components.icons: Use lucide-react with cyan/teal colors. For feature lists, consider enclosing icons in a soft cyan circular background.

sections.name: Hero
sections.description: High-impact scroll-controlled hero. Since video frames might not be available, use a tall container (e.g., h-[300vh]) with a sticky inner section (h-screen). As user scrolls down, different text overlays ('Your Robot COO', 'Across 6 Global Hubs', '3,000+ Companies') fade in and out, synchronized with useScroll progress.
sections.technical: Framer Motion: const { scrollYProgress } = useScroll({ target: containerRef }); Map opacity and display properties to specific scroll ranges.

sections.name: How It Works
sections.description: 3-step section: 1. Activate Your Robot COO, 2. Execute on the Ground, 3. Scale & Dominate.
sections.technical: Grid cols-1 md:cols-3. Use large glowing numbers (1, 2, 3) in cyan.

sections.name: Value Proposition
sections.description: Bento grid of cards highlighting key benefits.

sections.name: Events / Momentum
sections.description: Timeline view of company progress and events.
sections.technical: Vertical border-l-2 border-[#00F0FF] with relative positioning for timeline dots.

sections.name: Our Works / Case Studies
sections.description: Showcase of companies using the Robot COO.
sections.technical: Horizontal scroll or standard grid. Images with hover zoom effect.

sections.name: For Startups / Founders
sections.description: Targeted messaging for founders. Should visually contrast with the rest of the page.
sections.technical: Use the light gray background (#F8FAFC) here with a subtle cyan top/bottom border to differentiate.

sections.name: About the Founder
sections.description: Mariel Asami Fukase portrait and bio.
sections.technical: Two columns: image on left, text on right. Image should have a slight teal/cyan drop shadow.

sections.name: Contact / Get Your Robot COO
sections.description: Form to request access or contact.
sections.technical: Form with standard input/textarea components but customized with focus:ring-[#00F0FF]. Cyan glowing submit button.

hero_bg.description: White robot arm (used as the sticky background for the hero scroll effect)

network_concept.description: Futuristic tech network light (use in Value Prop or For Startups section)

founder_portrait.description: Modern female founder portrait representing Mariel Asami Fukase

robotics_general.description: White robot for 'How it Works' or Value Props

technical_instructions.styling: Use global index.css for complex glow effects. Example: .glow-cyan { box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.4); }
technical_instructions.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').
technical_instructions.files: Use pure .js extensions for React components. Do NOT use .tsx or TypeScript syntax.
technical_instructions.scroll_sync: Implement the hero scroll sync using Framer Motion's useScroll. Map scrollYProgress to opacity/y-axis of different text containers.
